brief: 5 things the skincare industry doesn't want you to know.

slots.headline: What Are They Hiding?
slots.subtitle: Five truths the beauty industry hopes you never discover.

slots.title: You Don't Need Ten Steps
slots.body: Cleanser, moisturizer, and sunscreen handle ninety percent of concerns. Extra layers dilute actives and irritate barriers. Fewer steps mean less waste and better results.

slots.title: Price Is Mostly Marketing
slots.body: Luxury packaging and celebrity endorsements inflate cost, not quality. Drugstore formulas often use identical active ingredients. Your wallet deserves better than pretty bottles.

slots.title: Natural Can Still Harm
slots.body: Essential oils and lemon juice burn and sensitize skin. Clean beauty lacks regulation, so 'plant-based' does not mean safe. Patch test everything, always.

slots.title: Your Barrier Does Everything
slots.body: A damaged barrier triggers acne, redness, and rapid aging. Harsh exfoliants strip this shield instead of helping it. Repair first, then treat.

slots.title: Consistency Beats Trendy Hype
slots.body: Chasing every viral ingredient resets your progress to zero. Skin needs weeks, not days, to show real change. Pick basics and stick with them.

slots.title: Your Next Move
slots.body: Stop buying fear and start trusting your skin. Share this with anyone drowning in expensive bottles. Knowledge is the only ingredient you need.
